entities.summary: The Kyiv History Museum is a museum in Kyiv that first opened in 1979. The museum has many displays of historical artifacts from the city and its surrounding areas, which tells stories about the history of Kyiv. Kyiv History Museum is a museum in Europe, established in 1982. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
